sections.description:
Short title and Commencement

ACT IOf-2012
ACT IOf-2012
WOMEN IN DISTRESS AND DETENTION
FUND (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2011
An Act further to amend the
Women in Distress
and
Detention Fund Act, 1996
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I,
5th January, 2012]
No. F.
9(15)12011-Legis., dated 5-1-2012.---The following Act
of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent
of the President on 30th December, 2011, is hereby published for general
information:--
Whereas it is
expedient further to amend the Women in Distress and Detention Fund Act, 1996
(XV of 1996), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:--
1. Short title
and Commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Women in Distress and Detention Fund
(Amendment) Act, 2011.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.
